reviews.review: This game wasn't exactly what people expected it to be (nor what the game developers initially promised) but it's a fun hack-and-slash nonetheless. I got this game very cheaply so I can't complain. You can finish it in one afternoon. A solid 7/10.

Excellent game. Sure graphics aren't the best but in my opinion still pretty good. I had close to no bugs glitches or anything else. The story was very intense and kind of surprised me in the end. It is always fun to fight for the emperor and kill some heretics. 10 out of 10 would recommend. Multiplayer is fine too. I just don't play it a lot.

Warhammer 40000: Space Marine was a very needed game and added a different aspect to the Warhammer genre. War, death, and demons are just a way of life in the Warhammer 40k universe. It's a crappy place to live, but makes an awesome setting for the third-person action game, Space Marine. I love my thunder hammer. I love the crackle of blue energy dancing across the weight on the end as my Space Marine – Ultramarines Captain Titus – hefts it backwards. I love swinging into the gurning face of an ork. I love chaining together three standard attacks, whirling and spinning with destructive force, before pressing F to slam my hammer into the floor, stunning every alien, monster, and monstrous alien in the vicinity. But life is difficult, because I also love my chainsword, and I can't carry both. Oh, and can I tell you about my power axe? I want to explain how satisfying it is to boot a Chaos cultist very hard in his scarred face before burying a five-foot axe in his shoulder. Sorry, hang on. I've got too excited. Let me calm down. Space Marine may stumble here and there, but manages to remain entertaining from start to finish and even with the minor glitch here and there that is miniscule to be honest and left me remembering great boss battles and encounters that made me feel like a god-like badass. This game was a breathe of fresh air and a must needed change form the normal games Warhammer has put out and it has made me fall in love with the Warhammer series all over again! This is a must needed playthrough for any fan of the franchise!
